summary: Iteration 76: UAE Blog Section Testing - All 28 blogs verified (14 demand planning + 7 Saudi + 7 UAE). 7 new UAE blogs added and working correctly. RSS feed (28 items), news-sitemap (28 URLs), and main sitemap (29 blog URLs) all updated. Blog routes work for both logged-in and logged-out users. GetMyPlan.in hyperlinks present in UAE blog content.

TEST_01_blog_index_loads.notes: Blog index page loads at /blog with data-testid='blog-index-page'

TEST_03_uae_category.notes: UAE (7) category filter shows exactly 7 posts

TEST_05_category_filters.notes: 8 category filters work: All(28), Software Reviews(2), How-To Guides(4), Industry Concepts(2), Data & Research(1), KPIs & Metrics(3), AI & Technology(2), Saudi Arabia(7), UAE(7)

TEST_06_uae_ramadan_dss_blog_renders.notes: Individual UAE blog post at /blog/uae-demand-planning-fashion-ramadan-dss renders correctly

TEST_07_getmyplan_hyperlinks.notes: 7 GetMyPlan.in hyperlinks found in UAE blog content

TEST_08_tables_present.notes: 3 tables found in UAE Ramadan/DSS blog content

TEST_10_uae_category_badge.notes: UAE category badge displayed on blog post

TEST_13_blog_logged_in.notes: /blog route works when user is logged in (not intercepted by AuthenticatedApp)

TEST_14_rss_feed.notes: RSS feed at /blog/rss.xml contains 28 items (all blog posts)

TEST_16_main_sitemap.notes: Main sitemap at /sitemap.xml contains 29 blog URLs (1 index + 28 posts)

App.js: Blog routes in public section before auth check
Blog accessible when logged in and logged out

context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 76 verified all 28 SEO-optimized blog posts including 7 new UAE blogs. Blog section is fully functional with proper routing, content rendering, GetMyPlan.in hyperlinks, internal linking, and public access. Blog routes work for both logged-in and logged-out users. RSS feed, news-sitemap, and main sitemap all contain 28 blog entries. UAE blogs include: Ramadan/DSS planning, multi-brand retail (Namshi/Ounass), luxury fashion (Dubai Mall), tourist season planning, VAT compliance, Jebel Ali port logistics, and consumer behavior.
